name: Turkey-Basil Fettuccine with Bell Peppers & Broccoli

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes; drain and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g fettuccine pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 red bell peppers
3 crowns broccoli
1 small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Trim, seed, and slice bell peppers into thin strips; place in a large bowl.
Preheat another large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom; add turkey and cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup butter, unsalted
1.02 kg ground turkey

instructions.primary_message: While the turkey is cooking, separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
When the turkey is done, add veggies to the pot; cook, stirring occasionally, until tender-crisp, 5-6 minutes.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
When the veggies are done, sprinkle with flour and continue to cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add milk, salt, and pepper to the pot with the turkey; cook, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
355 ml whole milk
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add drained pasta and basil to the pot; toss to combine and remove from heat.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
